# AI agents and agentic systems

## Summary

Modern agentic systems combine LLM planners with tool-use loops [[example-paper-aabbccdd]]. The dominant pattern is iterative planning over a tool registry [[example-paper-aabbccdd]].

> "Agentic systems repeatedly plan and act over a tool registry until a stop condition is met."
